newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National Textiles in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National Textiles in merger talks.

text.p: National Textiles Ltd said on Friday it was in merger discussions with another textile industry participant.
National Textiles said the merger could lead to a change in activities and in the ownership structure of the company. but added there could be no certainty as to the outcome of discussions.
In replying to an Australian Stock Exchange share price query, the company said it believed the announcement of merger talks was all that could be made at present.
National Textiles shares were suspended earlier on Friday.
